_doc: Example headlines the semantic classifier compares each article against (nearest-neighbour).
Positive examples are grouped by category; negatives are near-misses we want rejected.
Add real headlines from rejected.csv / events.csv here to teach it - no code change needed.
Thresholds are starting points; tune them with scripts/eval_labels.py after hand-labelling a sample.
